name.en: Chemical Admixture, Special Concrete and Modern Trends
name.gu: Chemical Admixture, Special Concrete અને Modern Trends

name.en: Repairs, Rehabilitation and Retrofitting of Concrete Structure
name.gu: Concrete Structure નું Repair, Rehabilitation અને Retrofitting

text.en: Select suitable concrete materials for site conditions and required works.
text.gu: Site conditions અને concrete work માટે યોગ્ય materials પસંદ કરો.

text.en: Prepare concrete of required specifications under different conditions.
text.gu: વિવિધ conditions માં જરૂરી specification નું concrete તૈયાર કરો.

text.en: Design concrete mix proportions for required specification.
text.gu: જરૂરી specification માટે concrete mix proportions design કરો.

text.en: Prepare special concrete using relevant admixture and concreting materials.
text.gu: યોગ્ય admixture અને materials વડે special concrete બનાવો.

text.en: Apply appropriate repairs and retrofitting techniques for concrete structures.
text.gu: Concrete structures માટે યોગ્ય repair અને retrofitting techniques લાગુ કરો.
